orchestration_patterns.behaviour: Validate IDs/states, bind approved versions, execute an explicitly chosen adapter, retain outputs and provenance, enumerate downstream review candidates
orchestration_patterns.test: Synthetic cross-film collision, duplicate usage channels and unresolved producers cannot create a handoff

orchestration_patterns.behaviour: Choose references, role, model, scope, variants, branch adoption and whether to continue or revise; log actor/version/scope
orchestration_patterns.test: A reused candidate remains approval-unknown until a separate decision

orchestration_patterns.behaviour: May propose decomposition, candidate role/model and context gaps with evidence; a human approves changes, code validates bindings and caps
orchestration_patterns.test: On fixed tasks compare human-only and assisted proposals with a declared rubric, repetitions, budget and independent adjudication; do not execute proposed links without approval
